अवृक a.
1 Free from danger,
[]
safe.
--2 Not hurting, inoffensive,
true.
--3 Free from one who
obscures.
--कं
1 Safety, peace,
security.
--2 Quiet, repose.

अवृत a.
1 Unchecked,
unimpeded.
--2 Unselected.
--3 Uncovered,
unprotected.
--4 Unsubdued.

आवृत p. p.
1 Covered, screened,
concealed.
--2 Invested, blocked.
--3 Enclosed, surrounded (by a
ditch, wall &c.).
--4 Spread,
overspread, overcast; आवृते नभस्तले

.
--5 Filled or abounding with.
--तः
A man of mixed origin, the son of
a Brāhmaṇa by a woman of the
Ugra caste;

.
--2
Repeated; द्विरावृत्ता दश द्विदशाः Sk.
--3
Learnt (by heart), studied;

अवृत्ति a. [न. ब.]
1 Not
existing, not present, not being in.
--2
Having no livelihood.
--त्तिः f.
1
Absence of subsistence or means of
livelihood, inadequate support;
अवृत्तिकर्षिता हि स्त्री प्रदुष्येत् स्थितिमत्यपि

अवृथा ind. Not in vain,
successfully.
--Comp.
--अर्थ a. successful,
gaining one's desired object.

अवृद्धिक a. Not augmentative,
not bearing interest (as capital).
--कं Original capital, principal.

Not increasing.
--2 Not promoting, not honouring.

अवृष्टि a. Not pouring down rain
(as a cloud).
--ष्टिः Want of rain,
drought; famine.

To cover, hide,
conceal; आवृणोदात्मनो रंध्रं

.
--3 To choose, desire.
--4 To enclose, obstruct, shut, hem
in, block; आवृत्य पंथानमजस्य तस्थौ

To cover or
conceal.
--2 To ward or keep off.

आवृतिः f. Covering, hiding; see
आवरण.

.
--2
Reversion, retreat, flight.
--3
Revolving, whirling, going round;

.
--4 Recurrence to the same
point or place (of the sun);
उदगावृत्तिपथेन नारदः

.
--5
Repetition of birth and death,
worldly existence; अनावृत्तिभयं

.
--6 Repetition in general;
an edition (modern use);
सप्तमीयमंकनावृत्तिः seventh edition.
--7
Repeated reading, study; आवृत्तिः
सर्वशास्त्राणां बोधादपि गरीयसी Udb.
--8 Use,
employment, application.
--9 Turn
of a way, course or direction.
--10
Occurrence.
--Comp.
--दीपकं a
rhetorical figure; त्रिविधं दीपकावृत्तौ
भवेदावृत्तिदीपकम् । (पदस्यार्थस्योभयोर्वा आवृत्तिः).
क्रमेणोदाहरणंः-वर्षत्यंबुदमालेयं वर्षत्येषा च
शर्वरी ॥ उन्मीलंति कदंबानि स्फुटांति कुटजोद्गमाः ।
माद्यंति चातकास्तृप्ता माद्यंति च शिखाबलाः ॥
Kuval.

To bestow, give
(Ved.).
--2 To turn to or towards.
--3 To choose. --

To bend,
bend down; incline; गौरवेणावर्जितः

.
--2 To subdue, win or
gain over, attract, please; आवर्जितानि
मनांसि

.
--6 To empty, pour out the
contents of (as a jar &c.); कलशमावर्जयति
Ś. 1;

To turn round,
revolve.
--2 To return, come or turn
back; धेनुराववृते वनात्

.
--3 To go to or
towards.
--4 To be restless or
uneasy;

To cause
to turn or revolve; अक्षबलयमावर्तयंतं

telling the beads.
--2 To roll,
turn about or over.
--3 To cause
to roll down, shed (as tears &c.).
--4 To attract, win over (see आवृज्)
--5 To repeat, recite.

आवृत् f.
1 Causing to turn
towards.
--2 Turning towards or
round; entering.
--3 Order,
succession, method, mode, manner;
अनयैवावृता कार्यं पिंडनिर्वपणं सुतैः

.
--4 Progress of an
[]
action; occurrence.
--5 Turn of a path,
course, direction.
--6 A purificatory
rite;

आवृष्टिः f. Raining, a shower
of rain.
